items.title: Independent Auditor Report
items.requirement: The filing must include a signed Report of Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm covering the consolidated financial statements.

items.title: Consolidated Statements of Earnings / Operations
items.requirement: Must disclose annual total revenue, cost of goods sold or operating expenses, and net income for the latest fiscal year.

items.title: Risk Factors Disclosure
items.requirement: Must disclose material business, supply chain, cybersecurity, or macroeconomic risk factors under Item 1A.
